sources.entry: Claude Code Observability Stack by Cole Murray - A Dockerized OpenTelemetry-to-Grafana observability stack for Claude Code that implements Anthropic's observability guidance, surfacing session activity, performance, token usage, and cost in prebuilt dashboards.

summary.one_liner: A Dockerized observability stack that receives Claude Code OpenTelemetry data through an OTel Collector and visualizes usage, cost, and performance in prebuilt Grafana dashboards backed by Prometheus and Loki.
summary.what_it_does: The stack runs an OpenTelemetry Collector that ingests Claude Code telemetry over OTLP (gRPC on 4317, HTTP on 4318), sends metrics to Prometheus and events/logs to Loki, and shows them in Grafana. The README describes dashboards covering cost by model, API request counts, token usage by type (input/output/cache/creation), tool usage and success rates, API latency and errors, and code productivity (lines changed, commits, pull requests). It lists metrics such as claude_code.session.count, claude_code.cost.usage and claude_code.token.usage, plus event types such as api_request, api_error and tool_result. Prompt content logging is controlled by an environment variable and is stated to be off by default. Management is done through make targets such as make up, make down and make validate-config.
use_cases: Track Claude Code spending by model
Monitor token usage across input, output and cache
Measure developer productivity from AI-assisted coding
Investigate Claude Code API errors and latency
Review tool usage and success rates in Claude Code
Build team dashboards for AI coding assistant usage
notable: Prebuilt Grafana dashboards for Claude Code cost, tokens, tools, performance and productivity
Follows the Claude Code observability documentation's metric and event naming
Configurable cardinality controls for session, version and account attributes
Prompt content logging off by default, toggled by OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
Single make-based workflow for starting, stopping and validating the stack
caveats: Requires Docker and running Prometheus, Loki, Grafana and an OTel Collector locally; the README does not describe a hosted option
Depends on the separate Claude Code observability documentation (CLAUDE_OBSERVABILITY.md) for the full configuration reference
Grafana default credentials are admin/admin as shown in the README
keywords: see how much claude code costs
